scope: Simplify the internal message lifecycle contract and use behavior-based method names without changing interruption or delivery policy
acceptance_criteria: Remove test-only state mutators, context rotation, and counters from the production contract
Use behavior-based names for generation, text completion, speech, and playback receipt operations
Keep message completion and VAD substeps private to their lifecycle owner
Remove the impossible turn-change result from interruption expiry
Preserve playback control ordering, stale-event checks, interruption recovery, prompt admission, and once-only completion
No new helper, facade, lifecycle owner, protocol, or dependency

ownership.coordinator: Production code, remaining lifecycle tests, verification, and integration
ownership.adapter_test_worker: Adapter internal package test migration only

risks: Tests that directly set state must retain equivalent scenarios through real lifecycle events
Completion must remain driven by successful output delivery and playback receipts, not generation alone
Interruption I/O boundaries must retain their existing ordering
baseline: Race tests passed in adapters/lifecycle and adapters/internal

implementation.behavior: Staged interruption configuration, playback control ordering, and completion eligibility remain unchanged

independent_review.summary: Confirmed behavior-preserving API removal and naming, private completion ownership, unchanged metric and idle eligibility guards, and retained interruption and playback regression coverage

declaration_organization_follow_up.scope: Move existing sentinel errors to error.go and package constants to constant.go, preserving names, types, values, and behavior

rollback: Revert only this internal API cleanup diff
